items.title: Amino acids ki activation aur translation ke marhale (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Protein banne se pehle jorne wali units tayyar ki jati hain. Khaas tRNAs khaas amino acids se jur kar aminoacyl-tRNAs (aa-tRNA) banate hain. Yeh reaction enzyme aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase karwata hai. Is enzyme ki 20 qismein hain; har qisam aik khaas amino acid se jurti hai aur us amino acid ke anticodon wale tRNA ko pehchaan kar us se bhi jurti hai. aa-tRNA amino acid ko ribosome tak pohanchata hai taa ke woh polypeptide zanjeer mein jur sake.

blocks.alt: Baen: bara hara enzyme, aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase, jo aik jagah amino acid aur doosri jagah tRNA thaame hai; tRNA ka anticodon wala sira enzyme ke andar. Teer azad aminoacyl-tRNA tak jahan amino acid tRNA ke oopar jura hai, protein banane mein hissa lene ke liye tayyar.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.17: Amino acids ki activation (kitab ki Figure 19.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Amino acid, tRNA, Anticodon, Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase, Aminoacyl-tRNA, Ready to participate in protein synthesis.

blocks.text: Is marhale mein in qadmon se initiation complex banta hai:

items: Pehla amino acid uthane wala aa-tRNA ribosome ki chhoti subunit se jurta hai. Is jurne ko initiation factor naam ka enzyme control karta hai. Prokaryotes mein pehla amino acid badla hua (modified) methionine, yaani N-formyl-methionine, hota hai; eukaryotes mein bina badla methionine.
Aik aur initiation factor mRNA ke 5′ sire ko chhoti subunit se jorta hai aur aa-tRNA ke anticodon ko mRNA ke pehle codon (AUG) ke oopar le aata hai.
Phir bari ribosomal subunit chhoti subunit ke oopar aa jati hai.

blocks.text: Is tarah bane initiation complex mein dono ribosomal subunits, pehla aa-tRNA, mRNA aur enzyme shamil hote hain.
Ribosome ki jis jagah pehla aa-tRNA baithta hai, wahan yeh sites hain:

items: Peptidyl site (P site): jahan amino acids ke darmiyan peptide bonds banenge.
Aminoacyl site (A site): jahan agla aa-tRNA aa kar jurega.
Exit site (E site): jahan se khaali tRNAs ribosome se bahar niklenge.

blocks.text: mRNA ke lehaaz se yeh teen sites 5′ se 3′ ki taraf E-P-A tarteeb mein hain, kyun ke ribosome mRNA ke 3′ sire ki taraf chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: chhoti ribosomal subunit, mRNA aur Met wala aminoacyl-tRNA jis ka anticodon UAC start codon AUG se jura hai. Hara teer initiation complex tak: bari subunit aa gayi, Met-tRNA P site mein, khaali E site aur khaali A site ke darmiyan.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.18: Translation ka initiation marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Aminoacyl tRNA, Smaller subunit, mRNA, Larger subunit, E site, P site, A site, Initiation complex.

blocks.text: 2- Elongation phase (zanjeer lambi hone ka marhala)
Initiation complex mein ribosome ki P site par pehla aa-tRNA hota hai (us ka anticodon mRNA ke codon se mila hua). mRNA ka agla codon A site par khula hota hai. Elongation in qadmon mein hoti hai:

items: Agla aa-tRNA, jis ka anticodon aur amino acid us codon ke mutabiq ho, elongation factor naam ke enzyme ki madad se A site par jurta hai.
Aik aur enzyme, peptidyl transferase, P site wale pehle aa-tRNA se methionine utaar kar use A site wale doosre aa-tRNA ke amino acid se peptide bond ke zariye jor deta hai.
Ribosome mRNA par 5′ se 3′ ki simt mein teen nucleotides aage sarakta hai. Is harkat ko translocation kehte hain.
Is ke nateeje mein do amino acids ki zanjeer wala aa-tRNA A site se P site par aa jata hai, mRNA ka naya codon A site par khul jata hai, aur khaali tRNA E site par aa kar ribosome se nikal jata hai.
Yeh qadam baar baar dohraye jate hain jab tak A site par stop codon na aa jaye.

blocks.alt: mRNA AUG CUG UCU par daire mein saat numbered qadam: (1) Leu-tRNA (anticodon GAC) A site mein aata jab ke Met-tRNA P site mein hai; (2) Met Leu par muntaqil, peptide bond banta hai; (3) ribosome aik codon aage, khaali tRNA E site se nikalta aur Ser-tRNA (anticodon AGA) aata hai; (4) Ser-tRNA A site se jurta; (5) Met-Leu zanjeer Ser par muntaqil; (6) ribosome aage, khaali tRNA bahar; (7) yeh amal har codon ke liye dohraya jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.19: Translation ka elongation marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har khaane mein bari aur chhoti subunits, E, P, A sites, anticodons UAC, GAC, AGA wale tRNAs aur barhti zanjeer Met, Leu, Ser.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chakkar mein: aa-tRNA A site mein aata hai, zanjeer us ke amino acid se jur jati hai, ribosome aik codon (teen nucleotides) aage barhta hai aur khaali tRNA E site se nikal jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 19.19 ke pehle teen khaanon mein teesra codon AAU chhapa hai aur baad ke khaanon mein UCU. Serine wale tRNA ka anticodon AGA sirf UCU se jur sakta hai (UCU = serine, jab ke AAU = asparagine), is liye hamare diagram mein har khaane mein UCU likha gaya hai.

Jab A site par stop codon aata hai to koi aminoacyl-tRNA A site par nahin aata, kyun ke stop codons ka koi anticodon nahin hota. A site par stop codon ko release factor naam ka protein pehchanta hai. Yeh P site wale tRNA se polypeptide ko azaad kar deta hai, aur yun translation khatam ho jati hai. tRNA bhi ribosome se chhoot jata hai aur ribosomal subunits mRNA se alag ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: ribosome jis ki P site mein UGG par tRNA (anticodon ACC) Met-Leu-Ser-Trp zanjeer thaame hai aur A site mein stop codon UAA; release factor qareeb aa raha. Beech: release factor A site mein, polypeptide tRNA se azad. Neeche: polypeptide, bari subunit, chhoti subunit, tRNA aur release factor mRNA se alag.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.20: Translation ka termination marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Release factor, Stop codon, Polypeptide, Larger subunit, Smaller subunit, tRNA, mRNA.

blocks.caption: Ribosome ki teen sites
rows: pehla aa-tRNA yahan baithta hai; peptide bonds bante hain
khaali tRNA yahan se nikalta hai

blocks.prompt: mRNA AUG UUU GGC UAA hai. Polypeptide mein kitne amino acids honge, aur zanjeer ko kaun rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teen amino acids: methionine (AUG), phenylalanine (UUU) aur glycine (GGC). UAA stop codon hai; A site par is ko release factor pehchaan kar polypeptide ko azaad kar deta hai.

items: 20 aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases amino acids ko un ke tRNAs se jorte hain.
Initiation: AUG par pehla aa-tRNA (prokaryotes mein N-formyl-methionine) P site mein.
Elongation: A site mein naya aa-tRNA, peptide bond, phir 3 nucleotides ki translocation.
